Getting There

The trailhead is at 41.42358, -85.23267 (tap for driving directions). Arrive early on weekends — trailhead lots at popular peaks fill quickly, and cell service is often unreliable once you leave the highway.

Spring through fall is the main season. Conditions change fast in the shoulder months — check a point forecast for the summit, not the nearest town, before you commit.

Most hikers should budget about 1.0 hours of moving time; add margin for breaks, photos and the descent.
